label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, strongly choosing a2, in the last ~5 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), only in episode trials 90-99 (mostly 95+), only when the previous trial was unrewarded (or a penalty; d1_err/penalty steps have very high rate), and only when the policy picks a2 (model_act==2, choice logit strongly negative), at low value (all activations in the lowest value bin). Never fires after a rewarded trial or when choosing a1. Activation is larger toward the window end (rel +1, the final trials of the episode). Episodes that started with S1 good (start_high=1) contribute 94% of mass, a hidden-variable correlate not included. Predicate uses only observed quantities (prev reward, the agent own policy logit, trial index); the alternative with action==2 (upcoming choice) gives the same recall. Precision is about 0.46: many late-episode unrewarded a2 GO steps stay silent, so the feature is an end-of-episode, low-value, a2-after-loss detector with incomplete precision.
